newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA SOUTHERN SECURITIES TAKES OVER BROKERAGE.
newsitem.headline: CHINA SOUTHERN SECURITIES TAKES OVER BROKERAGE.

text.p: China Southern Securities Co Ltd, one of the biggest brokerages in China, has taken over a securities house in northern Liaoning province, the Shanghai Securities News said on Thursday.
The new brokerage, called Financial Securities Co, would become a provincial trading hall under the administration of China Southern Securities Co Ltd, the newspaper said.
Financial Securities, set up in 1993, had total assets of 130 million yuan ($15.7 million) and generated accumulative profit of 3.38 million yuan by the end of 1996, it said but gave no more details.
China Southern Securities declined to comment.
